title: asdf TacoMaster's World
description: A mod which adds some funny mobs to the game, such as screaming possums and Skibidi Toilets!
body:
This is my first time making a mod without using MCreator! It adds some simple mobs that I think would be funny to have in Minecraft!


New mobs:

Possum - It runs around randomly and screams. Spawns in the overworld.

Among Us - They spawn anywhere in the overworld.

Imposter - They look exactly like a regular Among Us, but they can attack players! Deals 10 damage. Spawns in dark places, because they are sus.

Skibidi Toilet - Sings an annoying anthem, and spawns in dark places. They are hostile and deal 4 damage.

 

I plan to add more mobs in the future! Hopefully, I will be able to make more advanced mobs in the future (when I become more skilled at modding!)
